title: 第11章 洞房花烛第12章 饭桌风云
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
第11章洞房花烛
谢三刀等人狼狈不堪的离开，
如同被痛打的野狗，
江尘看着他们的背影，眼眸深处闪现过一丝凌厉杀意！
这种小人，若是在城外，他必然斩草除根，
可终究在天武城中，只能另寻机会了。
江家大厅中，
江长凌看着被揍的鼻青脸肿的谢三刀，
一脚踢了上去，
“废物！
一群废物，这么多人，连个江尘都收拾不了！”
“我要你们有什么用！”
“江家主，实在是江峰公子信息失误，您...您在给小人一次机会，小人一定不会让您失望...”
谢三刀连连告饶，
江峰眼神阴沉，
“父亲，是我低估了那个傻子，不，低估了江尘，咱们这些年都被他给骗了，恐怕他不光不傻，还很聪明，这次我全力以赴，绝对不会再给他一线生机！”
江长凌面沉如水，
“九宗大比招人在即，这个名额，是我好不容易给你争取来的，不能因为这件事耽误了，虽有林寒公子牵线，但要没有真才实学，怕也进不了九宗，只要你能成为东荒九宗任何一个宗门的内门弟子，以后获得的财富都是咱们江家十倍百倍。”
江峰却是有些沮丧，
“父亲，我一个凝气八重，怎么可能被九宗招收，还是咱们江家的产业重要。”

江长凌也叹了口气，
在天武城这种边境小城，
江峰或许算是年轻一代中的翘楚，
可与那些世家弟子，无论是天赋还是武技，都是天差地别，
“这些日子，你就好好练功，争取能在九宗大比前达到凝气十重，这门三阶武技，是我耗费了咱家半数积蓄换来的，你好好研习，只有进了宗门，咱们才有可能在往上走一步，至于江尘的事，还是我亲自来办。”
入夜，
房中火烛微亮，
随着吱呀开门声，
江海走进客房，手里拿着一盏热茶，
“尘儿，天不早了，快去休息吧，别让新娘子等急了。”
经过今天的婚礼，
江海对这个刚过门的孙媳妇有了不一样的看法，
虽然出身卑微，但礼数容貌都为上上等，
与江尘倒也般配，
江尘此时不知为何有些紧张，
“爷爷，其实我和她结婚是为了留在天武城，我们俩也没啥感情基础。”
“孙子，爷爷是过来人，感情都是需要培养的，当时我和你奶奶也是见了一次面就结婚了，后来天天一起睡觉，感情就有了。”
“不太好吧，我和她说过了，等我突破到凝气境，她随时可以离开江家。”
content_en:
Chapter 11 Bridal Room Flowers and Candles
Xie Sandao and others left in embarrassment.
Like a beaten wild dog,
Jiang Chen looked at their backs, a hint of murderous intent flashed deep in his eyes!
If such a villain were outside the city, he would definitely eradicate it.
But after all, in Tianwu City, we can only look for another opportunity.
In the Jiang family hall,
Jiang Changling looked at Xie Sandao, who had been beaten with a bruised nose and swollen face.
Kicked him up,
"Trash!
A bunch of trash, so many people, not even Jiang Chen can deal with it! "
"What do I need from you!"
"Master Jiang, Mr. Jiang Feng's information is really wrong. You...you are giving this villain a chance. I will definitely not let you down..."
Xie Sandao repeatedly begged for mercy.
Jiang Feng's eyes were gloomy.
"Father, I underestimated that fool, no, I underestimated Jiang Chen. We have been deceived by him all these years. I am afraid that not only is he not stupid, he is also very smart. I will go all out this time and I will never give him a chance of survival again!"
Jiang Changling's face was as sinking as water,
"Recruitment for the Nine Sects Competition is coming soon. I have worked hard to get this spot for you. You can't delay it because of this matter. Although Master Lin Han has helped you, if you don't have real talent and practical knowledge, I'm afraid you won't be able to enter the Nine Sects. As long as you can become an inner disciple of any of the Nine Sects of the East Barren, the wealth you will get in the future will be ten times and a hundred times that of our Jiang family."
Jiang Feng was a little frustrated.
"Father, how can I, who is at the eighth level of Qi Condensation, be recruited by the Nine Sects? Our Jiang family's industry is more important."
Jiang Changling also sighed,
In a small border town like Tianwu City,
Jiang Feng may be regarded as a leader among the younger generation.
But with those disciples from aristocratic families, both in talent and martial arts, they are completely different.
"These days, you should practice hard and strive to reach the tenth level of Qi Condensation before the Nine Sects Competition. I spent half of our family's savings on this third-level martial skill. You should study hard. Only by entering the sect can we take a step forward. As for Jiang Chen's affairs, I will handle it myself."
At night,
The candles in the room were dimly lit,
With the creaking sound of the door opening,
Jiang Hai walked into the guest room, holding a cup of hot tea in his hand.
"Chen'er, it's getting late. Go and rest quickly. Don't keep the bride waiting."
After today’s wedding,
Jiang Hai had a different view of this newly married granddaughter-in-law.
Although he came from a humble background, his manners and appearance were of the highest quality.
It matches well with Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen was a little nervous for some reason at this time.
"Grandpa, actually I married her to stay in Tianwu City, and we have no relationship foundation."
"Grandson, my grandpa has been here, and relationships need to be cultivated. At that time, your grandma and I also got married after meeting each other once. Later, we slept together every day, and we developed a relationship."
"It's not okay. I told her that she can leave the Jiang family at any time when I break through to the Qi Condensation Realm."
